# mesx-copilot-config

Universal GitHub Copilot agent configuration for the MESX platform. Clone this repo **once** per developer machine and VS Code auto-discovers all agents across every MESX repo you work in.

---

## Setup (One-Time per Developer Machine)

### 1. Clone this repo

```bash
git clone <repo-url> ~/mesx-copilot-config
```

### 2. Deploy the agents to VS Code

Pick **one** of the two methods below — both result in the same agents appearing in Copilot Chat.

---

#### Method A — Copy files to the VS Code user prompts folder (recommended)

VS Code resolves `.agent.md` files placed in its global **User/prompts** folder automatically, with no settings change required.

**Windows** (PowerShell):
```powershell
$dest = "$env:APPDATA\Code\User\prompts"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null
Copy-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\mesx-copilot-config\agents\*.agent.md" $dest
```

**Linux**:
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/Code/User/prompts
cp ~/mesx-copilot-config/agents/*.agent.md ~/.config/Code/User/prompts/
```

**macOS**:
```bash
mkdir -p ~/Library/Application\ Support/Code/User/prompts
cp ~/mesx-copilot-config/agents/*.agent.md ~/Library/Application\ Support/Code/User/prompts/
```

Agents are available immediately — no reload needed.

> **To update agents after a `git pull`**: re-run the copy command above.

---

#### Method B — Point VS Code to this repo's agents folder

Add the following to your VS Code **User Settings JSON**  
(`Ctrl+Shift+P` → `Preferences: Open User Settings (JSON)`):

```json
{
  "chat.agentFilesLocations": ["~/mesx-copilot-config/agents"]
}
```

> Windows: use the full path `"C:\\Users\\<you>\\mesx-copilot-config\\agents"`

Then run `Developer: Reload Window`. VS Code live-watches the folder, so future `git pull` updates are picked up automatically.

---

#### Method C — Create agents manually via VS Code UI

1. Open Copilot Chat → click the **agent picker** dropdown → **Configure Custom Agents**
2. Click **New Agent**
3. Name it (e.g. `Architect`) and paste the content from `agents/architect.agent.md`
4. Repeat for each agent

Use this if you cannot run terminal commands on your machine.

---

### 3. Verify

Open Copilot Chat (`Ctrl+Alt+I`) → click the **@** or agent dropdown — you should see **Architect**, **Implementer**, **Code Reviewer**, and **QA**.

---

## Keeping Agents Up-to-Date

```bash
cd ~/mesx-copilot-config && git pull
```

VS Code picks up changes immediately — no reload needed.

---

## Agents

| Agent | Purpose | Tools |
|-------|---------|-------|
| **Architect** | Architecture reviews, module boundaries, data flow mapping, ADRs | Read-only |
| **Implementer** | Write NestJS services, controllers, DTOs, entities, Vue components | Read + Edit + Execute |
| **Code Reviewer** | Review code quality, MESX patterns, security (OWASP), PR audit | Read-only |
| **QA** | Write Jest unit tests, Vitest component tests, E2E specs | Read + Edit + Execute |

### Recommended Workflow

```
Architect  ──handoff──▶  Implementer  ──handoff──▶  Code Reviewer  ──handoff──▶  QA
  (design)               (write code)               (review code)               (tests)
```

Each agent has **Handoff buttons** that appear after a response — click to transition with full context pre-filled.

---

## Layers — Skills, Instructions & Repo Facts

The `layers/` folder is organised by **layer type** first, then separates what is **shared across all repos** in that layer from what is **specific to a single repo**.

```
mesx-copilot-config/
├── agents/                              ← Universal agents (all repos, all layers)
│   ├── architect.agent.md
│   ├── implementer.agent.md
│   ├── code-reviewer.agent.md
│   └── qa.agent.md
│
└── layers/
    ├── ingestion/
    │   ├── skills/                      ← shared by ALL ingestion repos
    │   │   └── nestjs-module/SKILL.md
    │   ├── instructions/                ← shared by ALL ingestion repos
    │   │   ├── entity.instructions.md
    │   │   └── eventhub-dapr-binding.instructions.md
    │   └── repos/                       ← one entry per specific repo (facts only)
    │       └── mesx-master-data-ingestion/
    │           └── copilot-instructions.md
    │
    ├── backend/
    │   ├── skills/nestjs-module/SKILL.md
    │   ├── instructions/dapr-subscribe.instructions.md
    │   └── repos/mesx-downtime-backend/copilot-instructions.md
    │
    ├── api/
    │   ├── skills/nestjs-module/SKILL.md
    │   ├── instructions/entity-migration.instructions.md
    │   └── repos/mesx-master-api/copilot-instructions.md
    │
    ├── orchestrator/
    │   ├── skills/nestjs-module/SKILL.md
    │   ├── instructions/orchestrator-patterns.instructions.md
    │   └── repos/mesx-mv-orchestrator/copilot-instructions.md
    │
    └── processor/
        ├── skills/nestjs-module/SKILL.md
        ├── instructions/subscribe-cosmos-patterns.instructions.md
        └── repos/mesx-picking-mv-processor/copilot-instructions.md
```

### Adding a new repo

Only one file needs to be created here — the repo facts. The skills and instructions already exist at the layer level.

```bash
# Example: onboard mesx-production-data-ingestion (also an ingestion repo)
# 1. Add its facts file here (one new file):
#    layers/ingestion/repos/mesx-production-data-ingestion/copilot-instructions.md

# 2. Deploy to the actual repo:
REPO=~/mesx-production-data-ingestion
cp -r ~/mesx-copilot-config/layers/ingestion/skills       $REPO/.github/skills
cp -r ~/mesx-copilot-config/layers/ingestion/instructions $REPO/.github/instructions
cp ~/mesx-copilot-config/layers/ingestion/repos/mesx-production-data-ingestion/copilot-instructions.md \
   $REPO/.github/copilot-instructions.md

# 3. Commit so the whole team gets it on git pull:
cd $REPO && git add .github/ && git commit -m "chore: add Copilot context"
```

---

## Scope Reference

| Config Type | Location in this repo | Shared across | Distribution |
|-------------|----------------------|---------------|--------------|
| **Universal Agents** | `agents/` | All repos on your machine | Clone once + `git pull` |
| **Layer Skills** | `layers/<layer>/skills/` | All repos of that layer | `cp` → commit → team gets on clone |
| **Layer Instructions** | `layers/<layer>/instructions/` | All repos of that layer | `cp` → commit → team gets on clone |
| **Repo Facts** | `layers/<layer>/repos/<repo>/copilot-instructions.md` | That repo only | `cp` → commit → team gets on clone |
